name: Xenia Canary
requirement: Experimental native Linux Xbox 360 runner. Library Play accepts a verified XDVDFS ISO with root default.xex. No console BIOS required. Keyboard controller emulation is enabled; game compatibility and native saves need title-specific validation.

seed.contents:
[GPU]
gpu = "vulkan"
[General]
discord = false
[HID]
keyboard_mode = 1
[HID.Key]
keybind_start = "0x0D"
keybind_a = "J"
keybind_b = "K"
keybind_x = "U"
keybind_y = "I"
keybind_right_thumb = "H"
keybind_left_trigger = "Q"
keybind_right_trigger = "E"
